# Chain modules and parameters

Paxeer mainnet-beta is one BFT network, with EVM chain ID `125` (`0x7d`). The kernel runs inside `paxd` through `modules/lxphost` and participates in block proposal and execution. A receipt is final when its block is committed. The pre-merge execution/settlement split and independent checkpoint finality are retired.

This page preserves the declaration inventory from `modules/<name>/types/*.go`: `Params` fields, `Msg*` request types and proposal type constants. Counts describe source declarations, including historical ones; they do not establish that an operation is available. Registration in `node/app.go`, each module's `RegisterServices`, and the activation gates in `node/upgrades.go` determine the served behavior. Parameter names below are JSON field names, not node configuration keys; Go types are local to the owning package (`sdk` is the repository's SDK).

For client access, public JSON-RPC uses HTTPS at the root of `api1.mainnet-beta.paxeer.network` through `api14.mainnet-beta.paxeer.network`, or `api-mainnet-beta.paxeer.network`. Sub-chains are tenant domains in the shared database, described under [layerxchains](#layerxchains).

Related references: [system index](INDEX.md), [precompile declarations](precompiles.md), [kernel module declarations](kernel-modules.md) and [governance proposal declarations](governance.md). Those inventories also require registration and lifecycle checks before use.

## Lifecycle and governance

| Surface | Merged-network behavior | Implementation |
|---|---|---|
| `layerxanchor` | Historical state and replay compatibility; parameter writes retire at `v7.0`. Checkpoint submission is retired. Anchor views remain until `v7.0-anchor-store-delete`. | `modules/layerxanchor/keeper/msg_server.go`, `modules/layerxanchor/keeper/checkpoints.go`, `precompiles/layerxanchor/layerxanchor.go` |
| `layerxcustody` | Historical state and replay compatibility; all nine message handlers and its proposal handler refuse after merge activation. Withdrawal inclusion and forced-exit proof paths are retired independently of the activation height. | `modules/layerxcustody/keeper/msg_server.go`, `modules/layerxcustody/keeper/claims.go`, `modules/layerxcustody/handler.go` |
| `sequencer` | Embedded node ordering and consensus bookkeeping. `MsgSequenceBatch` is a proposer-injected block message after activation, refused by CheckTx; it is not a user transaction. | `node/sequencer`, `modules/sequencer/keeper/keeper.go` |
| `layerxbridge` | Retained external-chain bridge with governance-controlled registration, attestors, caps and pause; its default genesis registers no chains. | `modules/layerxbridge/module.go`, `modules/layerxbridge/types/genesis.go` |
| `layerxchains` | Tenant-domain registry, allowances, bonds, fees and governance pause within the same network. | `modules/layerxchains`, `precompiles/layerxchains` |
| Programs | Kernel activities and the `layerxprograms` precompile at `0x101D`; protobuf Msg/Query descriptors are compatibility declarations, without registered servers. | `src/modules/programs`, `precompiles/layerxprograms`, `modules/lxphost/read_program.go` |

The `v7.0` upgrade returns anchor bonds and releases stranded custody balances to the custody authority (`RetireAtMerge` and `ReleaseRetired`). Retained parameter fields and proposal codecs cannot reactivate those retired paths. At the EVM surface, `layerxVerify` (`0x1012`) and `layerxCustody` (`0x1013`) refuse at merge activation with `LXP_MODULE_DISABLED`; `layerxAnchor` (`0x1014`) refuses writes while retaining views until its later store deletion. Checkpoint submission and equivocation selectors already refuse unconditionally.

`layerxgov` proposals dispatch an allowlisted set of native governance messages through the node's message service registry in one cached transaction. Ledger, auth, pay and agent parameter updates require the governance module authority (`GovernanceAuthority()` in `modules/layerxgov/types/proposal.go`), wired in `node/app.go`. Each module's handler still enforces its own authority, validation and retirement rules. The tenant registry has a separate EVM `authority` field and no native `MsgUpdateParams` route; see [layerxchains](#layerxchains). Programs policy uses the kernel governance path, described under [Programs](#programs).

## layerxauth

Native parameter updates require the governance authority. `paused` is an operational control. `idempotency_retention` is retained in the parameter/genesis encoding for compatibility; the Go keeper stores it but does not apply it as a pruning policy to the kernel journal. Its declared unit is global sequence units, and zero denotes no expiry (`types/params.go`); do not infer an active retention schedule from that declaration.

## layerxchains

The live tenant registry is mounted by `node/app.go`. A domain is a namespace with allowances and accounting in the shared database; launching one does not launch another consensus network. Source: `modules/layerxchains/types/params.go` and `keeper/keeper.go`.

### Parameters

| Field | Go type |
|---|---|
| `authority` | `common.Address` |
| `min_bond` | `sdk.Int` |
| `creation_fee` | `sdk.Int` |
| `min_gas_allowance` | `uint64` |

| `max_chains` | `uint32` |

No native message or proposal types are declared. `RegisterServices` is empty; do not construct a tenant `MsgUpdateParams`. The `layerxchains` precompile at `0x101E` exposes domain operations. Its `governancePause` requires the configured `authority`; domain operators have separate operator controls. `keeper.SetParams` validates bounds and existing-domain capacity, but is not itself an exposed governance transaction. The parameter `authority` is an EVM address, distinct from the native governance authority string used by ledger/auth/pay.

## layerxcustody

Historical declaration inventory. At `v7.0`, all messages below and the `LayerXCustody` proposal handler return `ErrModuleRetired` (`layerxcustody` error code `29`). The precompile at `0x1013` returns `LXP_MODULE_DISABLED`. Legacy withdrawal/forced-exit proof verification already refuses regardless of height. Genesis import/export and retained asset/checkpoint records support historical state and replay; they do not provide a current deposit, withdrawal or forced-exit service.

`sequencer_authorizations`, `deposit_root_authority` and the delay/liveness fields below are retained legacy schema. They do not configure the embedded node ordering runtime. The merge release cancels pending claims and transfers custodied balances to the configured custody authority (`keeper/release.go`).

## lxphost

No parameters, messages or proposal types declared in `types/`.

This absence describes the Go inventory only. The host runs kernel activities inside the node and stages writes in the transaction's SDK store; node block commit persists their state. It also provides the read adapters used by native precompiles. See `modules/lxphost/host.go`, `modules/lxphost/ctx.go` and [Programs](#programs).

## Programs

Programs execute through the hosted kernel, with EVM access at `layerxprograms` (`0x101D`). The implementation is in `src/modules/programs` and `precompiles/layerxprograms`; `modules/lxphost/read_program.go` reads the committed kernel records. Use the implemented precompile ABI in `precompiles/layerxprograms/abi.json` for methods such as `getProgram`, `getInterface`, `getProgramOwner` and `getStateHead`.

Programs governance is handled by kernel governance activities, not a Cosmos Programs message server. Fee-policy staging and activation live in `src/modules/programs/fees.c` and the governance module under `src/modules/governance`; the declarations are in `include/layerx/programs.h`. Generated types under `precompiles/layerxprograms/types` retain Msg/Query descriptors only. Their generated registration helpers do not mean a Msg or Query server is mounted by the node. Do not treat those descriptors as callable governance or read routes.

## sequencer

The sequencer is embedded in the node's execution and proposal path. `MsgSequenceBatch` records the sequence range, hash chain and pinned receipt key at transaction index `0` after the stored activation height is reached. `DeliverSequenceBatch` validates the height, continuity and signature and rejects duplicate batches. CheckTx and ReCheckTx refuse it with `ErrBatchBlockOnly` (`sequencer` error code `8`); users do not submit it through the mempool. Source: `modules/sequencer/keeper/keeper.go` and `activation.go`.

There is no `Params` struct in `types/`, but the keeper also defines governed parameter-subspace keys `Leaders` (`LeaderList`) and `ReceiptKeys` (`ReceiptKeys`), in `keeper/leaders_param.go` and `keeper/receipt_keys.go`. The activation height and last committed sequence/hash are persisted keeper state, not parameters in the table. An admission receipt does not replace block-commit finality.

### Messages

- `MsgSequenceBatch`
